units.source_text: 那推心置腹的样子，异常优雅，美不可言。

en.t: That openhearted manner was extraordinarily graceful and beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 明石道人又向公子发了许多牢骚，为避免烦冗，恕不尽述。

en.t: The Akashi monk also poured out many complaints to the young lord, but to avoid tedious detail, I will not recount them all.

units.source_text: 又恐笔者记载失实，过分显露了道人性情的乖僻与顽固。

en.t: I also fear that my account may distort the facts and reveal too much of the monk's eccentric and stubborn nature.
